contract: M3-02 plants v2 (Muse, 2026-11-15) — UV completed for all textured slots; GPT textures applied via plant-materials.json
scope: models / UV / materials / LOD / display states only. Spawning, gathering yields and conditions, regrowth and saves are game-side (Claude). Alien in-game names and recipes are NOT decided here; names below are production classifications based on Earth plants.

plants.name: 竹
plants.productionUse: 茎材・繊維（制作上の分類）
plants.origin: base centre at (0,0,0); +Y up in glTF
plants.groundContact: y=0 plane; root flare sinks to y=-0.00 so the base never floats on flat ground
plants.stateSwitching: toggle visibility of the named state groups; parts_fruit is a child of state_full (hide it for the no-flower/no-fruit form)
plants.materialNote: no texture embedded in any GLB. Shared processed textures attach by material name via plant-materials.json (+ plant-materials.mjs); slots not listed there stay on the flat shared palette
plants.alphaMethod: geometry is opaque; single-leaf textures are cut by alphaTest against the geometry silhouette (intersection), no transparent blending and no sorting issues. needleA is composited opaque so the pine core mass never gets holes. See plant-materials.json alphaPolicy

recommendedCollider.note: 群生中心のみ。稈と稈の間は通行可とする前提

plants.respawnControl: whole-asset visibility + state groups are externally switchable, so the game can suppress display on buildings/roads
